summary.text: Time Difference grotto-heaven is a rank eight time path grotto-heaven on a heaven vein node among the two heavens.

claims.text: Fang Yuan annexes three rank eight grotto-heavens together: transformation path Grand Swine grotto-heaven, time path Time Difference grotto-heaven, and rule path Novelty grotto-heaven. The three sit on heaven vein nodes, are rich in resources, and have been taken care of by heaven’s will for many years. He splits them and places their pieces through the sovereign immortal aperture. Time Difference grotto-heaven has one super resource point.

Fang Yuan obtains the method of light blue translucent walls from Time Difference grotto-heaven. Its large resource points are encapsulated by walls of light, and the rate of time inside is many times faster than elsewhere, so the grotto-heaven has outstanding production of time path resources. He builds year essence sub-pools on that foundation so each sub-pool regulates a time path zone, accelerating resource production by over ten times and also slowing zones to cut Gu worms’ food needs.

Annexing Grand Swine, Novelty, and Time Difference and refining their heaven path dao marks lets Fang Yuan meet the lowest requirement for refining Four Elements Square Regret Blood Refinement Pool. Each of those grotto-heavens had merged with a nine heavens fragment. Time Difference grotto-heaven possesses over seven hundred thousand time path dao marks and over eight hundred heaven path dao marks.

Fang Yuan learns from Time Difference grotto-heaven and spends large material resources and effort constructing year essence sub-pools across the sovereign immortal aperture, creating various time path zones. With those zones and over nine thousand heaven path dao marks, feeding many rank eight Immortal Gu is eased.
After Fang Yuan annexes Grand Swine grotto-heaven and Time Difference grotto-heaven, he does not stop annexing others.

Fang Yuan notes that he used Time Difference grotto-heaven’s method to construct year essence pools and create different time path regions, and that because the areas have varying time flow, his deductions are even more complicated.
